list.name: agent
list.label: Agent
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT agent FROM runs WHERE agent <> '' ORDER BY 1

list.name: benchmark
list.label: Benchmark
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT benchmark FROM runs WHERE benchmark <> '' ORDER BY 1

list.name: subset
list.label: Subset
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(subset,''),'(none)') FROM runs WHERE benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model FROM runs WHERE model <> '' AND benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: config
list.label: Config
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(config_name,''),'(none)') FROM runs WHERE benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: agent_version
list.label: Agent Version
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(agent_version,''),'(none)') FROM run_trials ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Trials" FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at);

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN t.is_resolved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "Resolve %" FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at);

SELECT round(sum(t.cost_usd), 2) AS "Total Cost" FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at);

SELECT round(sum(t.cost_usd) / NULLIF(sum(CASE WHEN t.is_resolved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS "Cost/Resolved" FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at);

SELECT round(avg(t.n_total_tokens), 0) AS "Avg Tokens/Trial" FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at);

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN t.exception_type IS NOT NULL AND t.exception_type <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "Exception %" FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at);

panels.title: Model comparison
panels.description: 좌상단(높은 resolve% · 낮은 Cost/Resolved)이 최적. NULL 비용은 해당 모델에 비용 데이터가 없는 것.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.model AS "Model", t.model_provider AS "Provider", count(*) AS "Trials", round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN t.is_resolved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "Resolve %", round(avg(t.cost_usd), 4) AS "Avg Cost", round(sum(t.cost_usd) / NULLIF(sum(CASE WHEN t.is_resolved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS "Cost/Resolved", round(avg(t.n_output_tokens), 0) AS "Avg Out Tokens", round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN t.exception_type IS NOT NULL AND t.exception_type <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "Exception %" FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at) GROUP BY r.model, t.model_provider ORDER BY "Resolve %" DESC;

SELECT r.model AS model, round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN t.is_resolved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "resolve_pct" FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at) GROUP BY r.model ORDER BY "resolve_pct" DESC;

SELECT r.model AS model, round(sum(t.cost_usd) / NULLIF(sum(CASE WHEN t.is_resolved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS "cost_per_resolved" FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at) GROUP BY r.model HAVING sum(t.cost_usd) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "cost_per_resolved" DESC NULLS LAST;

panels.title: Config comparison
panels.description: 같은 model 안에서 config 변형별 성과 비교(A/B).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') AS "Config", r.model AS "Model", count(*) AS "Trials", round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN t.is_resolved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "Resolve %", round(sum(t.cost_usd), 4) AS "Cost", round(avg(t.n_total_tokens), 0) AS "Avg Tokens" FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at) GROUP BY 1, r.model ORDER BY "Resolve %" DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') AS config, round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN t.is_resolved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "resolve_pct" FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "resolve_pct" DESC;

SELECT $__timeGroup(t.finished_at, '1d') AS "time", COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') AS metric, round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN t.is_resolved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS resolve_pct FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Resolve % by agent version over time

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(t.finished_at, '1d') AS "time", COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') AS metric, round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN t.is_resolved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS resolve_pct FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Version comparison (Δ vs previous)
panels.description: 버전을 최초 등장 시각 순으로 정렬. Δ vs prev 가 음수면 회귀(성능 하락) 신호.

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent_version AS "Version", trials AS "Trials", resolve_pct AS "Resolve %", round(resolve_pct - lag(resolve_pct) OVER (ORDER BY first_seen), 1) AS "Δ vs prev", cost_per_resolved AS "Cost/Resolved", exception_pct AS "Exception %" FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') AS agent_version, count(*) AS trials, round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN t.is_resolved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS resolve_pct, round(sum(t.cost_usd) / NULLIF(sum(CASE WHEN t.is_resolved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS cost_per_resolved, round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN t.exception_type IS NOT NULL AND t.exception_type <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS exception_pct, min(t.finished_at) AS first_seen FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at) GROUP BY 1 ) s ORDER BY first_seen;

SELECT $__timeGroup(t.finished_at, '1d') AS "time", round(sum(t.cost_usd), 4) AS "Cost (USD)", sum(t.n_total_tokens) AS "Tokens" FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT t.exception_type AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND t.exception_type IS NOT NULL AND t.exception_type <> '' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at) GROUP BY t.exception_type ORDER BY value DESC;

panels.title: Hardest tasks (low resolve / high cost)
panels.description: resolve율이 낮고 비용이 큰 task Top 25 — 개선 우선순위 후보.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.task_name AS "Task", r.benchmark AS "Benchmark", count(*) AS "Attempts", round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN t.is_resolved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "Resolve %", round(sum(t.cost_usd), 4) AS "Cost" FROM run_trials t JOIN runs r ON t.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status = 'done' AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND r.benchmark IN (${benchmark:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.subset,''),'(none)') IN (${subset:sqlstring}) AND r.model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.config_name,''),'(none)') IN (${config:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.agent_version,''),'(none)') IN (${agent_version:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(t.finished_at) GROUP BY t.task_name, r.benchmark ORDER BY "Resolve %" ASC, "Cost" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 25;
